events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention — First Since 1998
events.description: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention. First joint US-Japan FX intervention since 1998. Treasury Sec Bessent's notepad read 'To Do Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil'. NY Fed sold euros to buy yen. Japan and US confirmed intervention on Aug 3, standing ready to act again.

events.title: Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis, Tanker Attacks, Ceasefire Stalemate
events.description: Active US-Iran war (Day 157+). Iran claims strikes on 2 ships in Strait of Hormuz. Oil tanker attacked by UAV Aug 1. Ceasefire negotiations stalled — Trump claims talks ongoing, Iran denies. Iran rejected 15-point peace plan. Iran making ceasefire conditional on Lebanon war resolution. Hormuz disruptions caused Brent to jump 10-13%.

events.title: Ebola Epidemic PHEIC — Bundibugyo Virus Intensifying in DRC/Uganda
events.description: WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 16, 2026. Outbreak is INTENSIFYING with sustained transmission. 1,707 confirmed deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. Bundibugyo virus strain. As of first week of August, situation worsening.

events.title: Gold at $4,060/oz — Safe Haven Panic Above $3,500 RED Threshold
events.description: Gold trading near $4,060/oz, well above $3,500 RED threshold. Driven by US-Iran war, yen intervention, sovereign debt concerns. Analysts expect range $3,580-$4,645 for August. JP Morgan forecast $4,000 by mid-2026 — already exceeded.

events.title: Japan-South Korea-US Trilateral FX Intervention — Unprecedented
events.description: South Korea joined Japan and US in unprecedented joint FX intervention. Won hit 9-month high. First trilateral coordinated currency intervention. BOJ held rates at 1% (8-1 vote, Takata dissenting for 1.25%). BOJ warned core inflation exceeding 2% target. JGB yields at 2.85% (above 2.5% threshold).

events.title: OPEC+ Production Quota Increase — 188,000 bpd for September
events.description: OPEC+ (7 members: Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, Oman) agreed Aug 2 to boost production quota by 188,000 bpd for September. Continuing unwind of 2023 voluntary cuts. Brent declining from April 2026 peak (~$117) to ~$85-92 range. EIA forecasting $74/b average. Members cannot fill existing quotas.

additional_findings.title: ECB Held Rates at 2.25%, September Hike Bets at 70%
additional_findings.description: ECB held at 2.25% on July 23. Markets pricing 70% chance of September hike due to oil price surge from Iran war. German 10Y Bund above 3.0% threshold at 3.15%. Merz rejects EU €1.7trn budget proposal.

additional_findings.title: BOE Held Rates, Warns Ready to Raise if Iran War Escalates
additional_findings.description: BOE held rates, explicitly flagged Iran war as inflation risk. Worst-case oil at $100/bbl could push UK inflation to 3.2%. Sterling slipping to 1.3450. UK facing drought-related food shortages.

additional_findings.title: Argentina Defaults on R$63M Debt to Brazil Casa da Moeda
additional_findings.description: Argentina defaulted on two debt payments to Brazil's Casa da Moeda, breaking agreement. Diplomatic and financial tension escalating.

additional_findings.title: Mali Offensives, Ethiopia TPLF Conflict Resurgence, Sahel Deterioration
additional_findings.description: Mali coup attempts, JNIM kidnapping, TPLF seizing areas in Ethiopia, Sahel jihadist insurgency pushing southward. Russian Africa Corps retreat from northern Mali.

additional_findings.title: COVID-19 Growing in 41 US States
additional_findings.description: CDC estimates COVID-19 infections growing or likely growing in 41 states as of July 29, 2026.

additional_findings.title: Russia Sberbank Warns Rising Corporate Credit Risks
additional_findings.description: Russia's largest lender reports deteriorating loan book, impaired loans increasing. Wartime debt boom creating banking vulnerability.

scan_summary: CRITICAL: 6 category-5 events detected. Active US-Iran war with Hormuz disruptions, unprecedented US-Japan-Korea trilateral FX intervention, gold at $4,060, Ebola PHEIC intensifying, OPEC+ quota increase. Global risk environment at CRITICAL.
